steps.label: Clause 4.1 – Understanding the organization and its context
steps.description: Start by defining relevant internal and external issues, determine the purpose of your AI systems (provider, producer, customer), and establish a process for reporting concerns. (Req. 4.1, Annex A - Control A.3)

steps.label: Clause 4.2 – Understanding the needs and expectations of interested parties
steps.description: Identify stakeholders and decide which of their needs to address. (Req. 4.2, Annex A - Control A.10)

steps.label: Clause 4.3 – Determining the scope of the AI management system
steps.description: Define boundaries and applicability regarding ISO 42001 clauses, controls, and objectives. (Req. 4.3)

steps.label: Clause 4.4 – AI management system
steps.description: Create necessary processes and interactions to operate and control your AI management system. (Req. 4.4, Annex A - Controls A.6 & A.7)

steps.label: Clause 5.1 – Leadership and commitment
steps.description: Secure senior management sponsorship, integrate ISO 42001 requirements into business strategy, and allocate resources. (Req. 5.1)

steps.label: Clause 5.2 – AI policy
steps.description: Establish an AI policy aligned with organizational purpose and quality objectives. (Req. 5.2, Annex A - Control A.2)

steps.label: Clause 5.3 – Roles, responsibilities and authorities
steps.description: Define, communicate, and document roles and accountabilities within the AI management system. (Req. 5.3, Annex A - Control A.3)

steps.label: 6.1.1 General
steps.description: Define a risk-based approach to managing AI-related risks and opportunities.

steps.label: Clause 6.1.2 – AI risk assessment
steps.description: Identify, analyze, and evaluate threats and opportunities for AI systems. (Req. 6.1.2)

steps.label: Clause 6.1.3 – AI risk treatment
steps.description: Develop and implement measures to mitigate high-priority AI risks. (Req. 6.1.3)

steps.label: Clause 6.1.4 – AI system impact assessment
steps.description: Assess societal, ethical, and operational impacts before deployment. (Req. 6.1.4, Annex A - Control A.5)

steps.label: Clause 6.2 – AI objectives and planning
steps.description: Set measurable objectives and plan how to achieve them. (Req. 6.2 & 6.3)

steps.label: Clause 6.3 – Planning of changes
steps.description: Ensure controlled and communicated changes to the AI management system.

steps.label: Clause 7.1 – Resources
steps.description: Provide people, infrastructure, and technology needed. (Req. 7.1, Annex A - Control A.4)

steps.label: Clause 7.2 – Competence
steps.description: Identify required skills and provide training. (Req. 7.2)

steps.label: Clause 7.3 – Awareness
steps.description: Promote understanding of roles in AI management. (Req. 7.3)

steps.label: Clause 7.4 – Communication
steps.description: Establish internal and external communication processes. (Req. 7.4)

steps.label: Clause 7.5 – Documented information
steps.description: Control creation, update, and retention of documents and records. (Req. 7.5, Annex A - Controls A.8 & A.9)

steps.label: Clause 8.1 – Operational planning and control
steps.description: Implement and control processes to meet AIMS requirements. (Req. 8.1)

steps.label: Clause 8.2 – AI risk assessment
steps.description: Perform ongoing risk assessments during operations. (Req. 8.2)

steps.label: Clause 8.3 – AI risk treatment
steps.description: Apply risk treatment plans in live environments. (Req. 8.3)

steps.label: Clause 8.4 – AI system impact assessment
steps.description: Re-assess impacts as changes occur. (Req. 8.4)

steps.label: Clause 9.1 – Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
steps.description: Track KPIs, metrics, and performance.

steps.label: Clause 9.2 – Internal Audit
steps.description: Plan and conduct regular internal audits. (Req. 9.2)

steps.label: Clause 9.3 – Management Review
steps.description: Review AIMS performance with top management. (Req. 9.3)

steps.label: Clause 10.1 – Continual Improvement
steps.description: Identify and act on opportunities to enhance the AIMS. (Req. 10.1)

steps.label: Clause 10.2 – Nonconformity and Corrective Action
steps.description: Address nonconformities, correct root causes, and prevent recurrence. (Req. 10.2)
